_about: Loupedeck+ MIDI hardware map (what each physical control sends). Lightroom actions live in a separate mapping file.

_encoding.dial_turn: control_change on the dial's number: value 1 = one detent clockwise, 127 = one detent counter-clockwise (two's complement -1). Never any other value, so no hardware acceleration.
_encoding.press: note_on velocity 64 on press, note_off velocity 64 on release. Velocity is constant, so presses are not pressure-sensitive; hold time is measurable.
_encoding.dial_click: a dial's click is a note with the same number as its CC

_hsl_names: The 8 colour dials follow Lightroom's HSL order: user's 'light blue' = aqua, 'dark red' = magenta.

colour_dials._note: The 8 colour dials change number with the colour mode: the lit HUE/SAT/LUM button, or B&W mode (clr/bw button; all three lights off). The device tracks the mode itself, so the number alone gives mode + colour. Click = note with the same number (all 32 seen). Re-pressing the lit mode button keeps the same bank (radio-style, no 'off'). Sources: captures/raw-20261116-003148.jsonl, raw-20261116-003645.jsonl, raw-20261116-003937.jsonl.

_never_seen: CC 43 and 47 (gaps in the tone-dial range) never appeared in any capture; probably unused.
